scenes.title: She sat up in her crib for the tenth time
scenes.voice: Four forty a.m. A thirteen-month-old sits up in her crib for the tenth time.

scenes.title: Lay her down — she sits up. Again.
scenes.voice: Mom lays her down, she sits up. Again and again, until both are exhausted.

scenes.title: things I asked her mom NOT to do
scenes.voice: Three things I asked her mom not to do.

scenes.title: Don't lay her back down ten times
scenes.body: It turns into a roly-poly game
scenes.voice: One. Don't lay her back down ten times. It becomes a roly-poly game.

scenes.title: Don't add rocking
scenes.body: It swaps one habit for another
scenes.voice: Two. Don't add rocking. That just swaps one habit for another.

scenes.title: Don't interrupt the wriggling
scenes.body: Her body is learning to settle
scenes.voice: Three. Don't interrupt when she wriggles. That's how her body learns to settle.

scenes.title: She's learning to calm herself down
scenes.voice: Sitting up at night, she's learning to calm herself down.

scenes.title: Try: one night, just stay close
scenes.body: Time how long until she lies down on her own
scenes.voice: Try one night of just staying close, and time how long until she lies down on her own.

scenes.title: Want a plan for your child?
scenes.voice: Want a plan for your child? Message me on WhatsApp.
